page.layout: Running head at top, centred, with page number 187 at top right. One column of text. One marginal note at right, beside the lines "dum æs alienum" to "eo modo". Signature "O 2" at the foot, centred-left, and catchword "utque" at the foot, right.

main_text.p: testis jurati, modò is non fit in ministerio ipsius Oldermanni, qui reijci[?] ut suspectus po-test. Oldermannus & judices hi nihil potestatis, aut jurisdictionis sibi usurpent in agrarios praeter id, quod ad ipsorum cognitionem proprie pertinet: Idem Oldermannus ad hoc tribunal suum neminem citet ex agro nisi per mandatum Camerae provincialis, id est, Praefidis & Hovetmannorum: agrarii & peregrini à sententia hujus tribunalis Hovetmannos cum praesidè, cives senatum urbanum appellent, & recognitionem petant: Huic sententiae in consessu Ordinum generalium pronunciatæ, & nomine eorundem à summo scribâ à secretis subscriptæ, addidere judices iidem aliam quoque eodem die & loco. In eâ concedunt agrariis ad exsolven-Sententia tertia eo-rundem.dum æs alienum tributum agro toti imponere secundum jugera per octennium eo modo, quem ipsi sufficere arbitrabuntur, atque insuper ex bonis monasticis ex decreto Ordinum generalium aureorum xvi millia caperę[?]. Ut tamen æs hoc alienum priùs liquidum fiat apud ipsos provinciae Ordines, nec excedat summam lxiv millium aureorum, quam summam ipsi agrarii antè erant professi

page.notes: Running head: "Vrbe" printed, spelled Urbe per u/v rule. The macron over the final a of "Groningā" is kept. "reijci" is doubtful (the j/i letter is unclear). "fit" may be "sit"; I read "fit" from the scan. "caperę" is uncertain: the final letter with its abbreviation mark is hard to read. "professi" ends the last full line; the word may be broken with a mark, not clear. The note "Sententia tertia eorundem" is set in smaller type; I read "eo-rundem" from its line break. Show-through and a faint digitiser watermark at the lower right are excluded.
